Freelance Project: Automated Python Web Server Log Parser & Linux Hardening Script
Client: FinOps Cloud LLC (Remote / Worldwide)
Budget: $800 - $1,200 USD (Milestone-based payment)
Duration: 2 weeks

Project Description:
We are looking for a cybersecurity-oriented developer/engineer to build an automated Python log analysis utility and a Linux server hardening checklist/script for our staging environment.

Key Deliverables:
1. Python CLI tool to parse Apache/Nginx combined access logs, identify IP addresses performing directory traversal, SQL injection patterns, or excessive 404/500 errors, and export CSV/JSON reports.
2. A clean Bash hardening script for Ubuntu 22.04 LTS: enforce SSH key authentication, disable root login, configure UFW firewall rules, and set up basic auditd rules.
3. Test documentation and execution verification guide.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Code must run cleanly on Ubuntu Linux with Python 3.10+.
- Zero false positives on standard test datasets provided by client.
- Complete documentation with clear operational runbooks.

Access & Authorization:
- Testing will be conducted strictly on a containerized Staging sandbox provided by the client. No access to production or credentials required.
- Formal Letter of Authorization (LOA) for security testing will be signed.
